summary: NRX Pharmaceuticals, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a firm-commitment underwritten public offering of common stock. The offering size, price, and underwriter details are blank as terms are not final. Common stock is listed on Nasdaq under NRXP; last reported sale price on June 1, 2026 was $4.62 per share. Underwriters include BTIG as lead manager. This is a routine equity shelf takedown to raise capital, not a special situation. There are no acquirer, target, activist, or restructuring elements; it is merely a capital-raising transaction.
